name: The Great Kapok of Hofi Pastor
age_estimate: not documented (local claims of 400 to 800 years)

location.address: Hofi Pastor, behind Barber church, Kaminda Popo Royer, Barber, Soto

access: Hofi Pastor nature park (about 12 ha, opened as a native-plant garden in 1996) is open to visitors; small entry fee about NAf 5 cash paid to the ranger at the entrance (takeyourbackpack, page updated Oct 2026); one guide says entry usually free, so fee is unsettled; hours not found. Two walking trails pass the tree (Wikipedia, komoot).
transport: About 30 to 45 minutes by car from Willemstad; buses rare (takeyourbackpack). No public transport time verified.
verify_notes: Island's famous oldest tree, repeatedly named so by Wikipedia (Barber article), komoot highlight 'Ancient Kapok Tree in Hofi Pastor' (Natural Monument highlight), a 2016 travel blog, takeyourbackpack (updated Oct 2026), and Seafari's landhuizen guide ('reputedly the oldest tree on Curacao', behind Landhuis Barber, old orchard). AGE IS UNSETTLED: 800 years is the common claim (Wikipedia cites Inlander 2017 and ANWB guide 2017, not seen) but one blog says brought over 400 years ago by the Caiquetios, which contradicts 800; another source says 300 or 600. Kapok is a fast-growing species, no dating exists; leave age empty and treat as legend, not measurement. No girth or height found on any fetched page. Descriptions: massive trunk, wide plank-like buttress roots, crown above the scrub. Site history: orchard bought by Pastor (Mgr) Niewindt in the early 1800s per two sources that disagree on the exact date; Landhuis Barber plantation founded early 18th century by Barbara van Exteen (monuments register, curacaomonuments.org, cadastral 3-H-19). Pin: komoot user-submitted highlight coordinate (12.290883, -69.073447, 20 m); Nominatim puts the Hofi Pastor bus stop at 12.29016, -69.07477, about 130 m away. Tree lies in the park, on the trail; not confirmed on a crown, so approximate. Alive: all current guides (takeyourbackpack Oct 2026) describe it standing; no dated tree photo checked; lifecheck not run. Register: Hofi Pastor not found in curacaomonuments.org (which lists Landhuis Barber, the house). One independent source cluster only (tourism and Wikipedia); flagged. Park is a ranger-run nature preserve; visit not private. Not covered country (Curacao not on 100+ list).
